title: Inviting pleasure without a clear forecast

captions.physics: Agreeing on a new pleasure together
captions.energy: Waiting for another perspective before beginning

meaning: A free trial supports shared enjoyment when waiting for a suitable moment leaves you able to begin without knowing exactly how you will feel.
text: You can choose something pleasant together without a clear picture of the eventual impression. The Lovers in the physical position of Svadhisthana describe agreement: offering something new, hearing wishes and finding an option for both. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards delaying while conditions are reconsidered or another perspective appears. The Moon in emotions leaves the response unclear, with anticipation mingling with doubt. Shared choice promises no identical feeling, while continued waiting can make uncertainty loom larger. Pleasure sometimes needs space for experience that has yet to find precise words.

For example, you choose a workshop where you can decorate cups for yourselves. The invitation appeals to both, yet the decision waits: perhaps painting will be dull or enjoyment different from expectation. **A shared experience need not promise a particular feeling beforehand.** You can agree to a small trial and discuss impressions later. One might enjoy colour, the other conversation over the drawing, without immediately giving the idea a single verdict.

The difficulty is seeking a readiness that removes every vague doubt. You revise the invitation and discuss conditions again while actual desire becomes harder to hear. Imagined impressions fill the pause. Another perspective helps when it opens participation. Sufficiently clear agreement leaves room for an unclear feeling you can share afterwards, beyond making it an obstacle to every invitation.
